name: Maxxus S-Line Yoga 2-Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna (Canadian Hemlock) - Natural
description: Looking for a stylish way to bring wellness and relaxation into your home? The Maxxus S-Line is a premium two-person FAR infrared sauna designed to elevate your health and comfort. Built from natural reforested Canadian Hemlock, it combines durability with modern elegance, making it a perfect fit for any home interior. Inside, you’ll find low EMF carbon heating panels that provide gentle, even warmth to support detoxification and rejuvenation. Features like chromotherapy lighting with a red light option, a tempered glass door, an interior LED control panel, and built-in Bluetooth/MP3 speakers create a complete spa-like experience. With its easy clasp-together assembly, this sauna is designed for effortless setup—bringing daily relaxation and long-term wellness right into your living space. Features: Full 2 person capacity 7 Maxxus Low EMF (EMF between 5-10MG - 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels) FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock wood construction Clear Tempered glass door Interior chromotherapy lighting system with Red Light Feature Interior LED Control Panel Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connection with built in speakers 118F-132F is the ideal temperature range, sauna can heat up to 140F Clasp together assembly Ships in 2 boxes Note: Indoor Use Only Specifications: Sauna weight: 330 lbs. Shipping weight: 385 lbs. Electrical service: 120V/15 AMP Non GFCI plug & play (Recommend Dedicated Outlet) Exterior dimensions (LWH): 42" x 48" x 75" Interior dimensions (LWH): 37" x 44" x 68" Document: View Owner's Manual
